name: conflux
description: Conflux: a real-time collaborative workspace. Collaboration in sync.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:lan -w server" "npm run dev:lan -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
